name: Data Science and Analytics
description: Data science programmes teach how to get a defensible answer out of data — statistics and study design, programming, machine learning, and handling data at a scale that breaks a spreadsheet. It is among the newest programmes in the Florida catalogue, and it is still settling: the same subject is awarded under two federal codes and a range of names.
degreesNote: Florida awards these credentials at associate, bachelor’s and master’s level, plus short certificates, and the level varies between institutions far more than in older programmes — several state colleges award an associate degree in it while several universities start at master’s. ⚠ Two codes share the field, Data Science and Data Analytics, each awarded by ten Florida public institutions; the names are not a reliable guide to what is taught, so read both catalogues. There is no licence and no accreditation requirement here — what an employer looks at is the work you can show.

cips.note: Data Science — ten Florida public institutions, weighted toward associate degrees at state colleges with three bachelor’s and three master’s programmes above them.

Data Analytics — the sibling code, also ten institutions and more of it at baccalaureate and master’s level. ⚠ Included because Florida institutions use the two names interchangeably; a student searching only for "data science" would miss half the state’s provision.

related.note: The larger and older programme, available at far more institutions — 41 award computing credentials against thirteen here. ⚠ If no data degree is near you, a computing degree with statistics coursework is the standard route into this work, and it is more portable.

⚠ The foundation this programme is built on. Statistics goes deeper into inference and study design and travels further into research, biostatistics and government; data science trades some of that for programming and machine learning.
